messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke perf + quality sweep for int4+fp8 mix on model-x? I pushed PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/432 and inline config in the PR. Goal: validate throughput uplift and check eval regression <= 0.5% on our chat-eval set. Need numbers by EOD PST. Anyone can pick this up? :wave:

sam: I'll take it. Which machine pool and batch profile? also do you want kv-cache enabled?

maria: thanks! Use pool: ded-gpu-v3-16, profile: burst-small (batches up to 8, seq 512). KV cache: enabled. Use quant flags:
```
--quant-mode=int4
--fallback=fp8
--profile=perf+latency
--eval-set=chat-eval-2026
--add-perf-counters
```
Run 30-min warmup then 1k requests sampling. Target 95p latency <120ms and throughput >=600 tps.

jordan: Clarify accuracy gate — 0.5% absolute drop vs baseline or relative? Also want token-level BLEU or response-level AUC?

maria: absolute vs baseline (openai-compat baseline run from last week). Use response-level pass@1 metric we use in the eval harness. If regression >0.5% we fail.

lee: heads up, ded-gpu-v3-16 has a maintenance window 18:30-19:00 PST. Schedule accordingly.

ops-bot: Job claim posted by sam at 1904123600. CI:perf-suite started. :robot_face:

sam: kicked off now, will post raw numbers. adding perf counters + linux perf sampling. If it looks flaky I'll run single-instance microbench with perf recording.

abrams: please add `--quant-fallback-threshold=0.02` to avoid pathological fp8 fallbacks on some layers we've seen.

sam: good call, added that flag and requeued.

sam: Quick results after 45m warmup (summary):
```
baseline (fp16): throughput=540 tps, 95p latency=140ms, pass@1=0.842
int4+fp8 mix: throughput=678 tps (+25%), 95p latency=118ms, pass@1=0.836 (-0.6%)
```
Notes: most regression concentrated on long-dialog prompts (>800 tokens). tail latency improved overall but variance increased on single-instance runs.

maria: thanks. pass@1 drop 0.6% > 0.5% gate. Can you attach eval diffs and example failures? Might be a prompt truncation or kv-cache interaction.

sam: uploading eval-diff.jsonl and a small repro script. Example failure: model adds hallucinated sentence on long-dialog cases. Repro script pinned.

jordan: looks like an attention scaling artifact with int4 per-layer rounding. Suggest rolling quant table for key layers or enabling selective fp8 for attention dense.

abrams: I can take a quick quant-policy PR to pin attention->fp8 for layers [2..4] and run a targeted sweep. ping me if you want immediate patch.

maria: yes please. abrams, if you can open PR and tag `@maria` and `@sam` we'll iterate. For the rollout plan: canary to 10% on dedicated first, monitor eval and tail-latency. No full rollout until pass@1 within 0.5%.

sam: ack. I'll hold the production rollout and run the targeted microbench after abrams' PR.

abrams: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/438 -- includes quant-policy + a test harness. cc @maria @sam

maria: cheers. schedule follow-up async thread in two hours to check results. :thumbsup:
